'''Gek''' was<ref name="TOR" /> a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a conflict fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. They were deployed as a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] selling [[Starship/Legends|starship]] upgrades for military personnel on [[Carrick Station]], a massive [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]].<ref name="TOR" />

Gek had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin, amber-colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], as well as facial [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]],<ref name="TOR" /> which were usual for their [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Zabrak}}</ref> The captain wore a black-and-blue Republic Navy [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]] with orange-and-silver accents.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gek first appeared as a starship upgrades vendor for Republic players in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] released by [[BioWare]].<ref name="TOR" />
